label: Soniox
description: Live and recorded transcription, speakers told apart
agentGuide: Listening to a microphone in real time is the job of the Recordr plugin, not of this relay. Transcribe a recording by URL: POST /v1/transcriptions {"model": "stt-async-v5", "audio_url": "https://.../audio.mp3", "language_hints": ["fr"], "enable_speaker_diarization": true} returns an id; GET /v1/transcriptions/<id> until status is "completed" (or "error"), then GET /v1/transcriptions/<id>/transcript (text, and tokens with their speaker and start_ms). A local file cannot be sent through this relay (binary body): give a URL. Delete a transcription once read: DELETE /v1/transcriptions/<id>. Models: GET /v1/models. The key is set by Allkin.
